versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill.
- Transforms raw creative ideas, stories, or briefs (including Chinese) into a director/screenwriter treatment, script, shot breakdown, and Seedance 2.0-ready video prompts.
- Implements a step-by-step workflow: concept extraction, scriptwriting, shot listing, and detailed prompt generation tailored for Seedance 2.0.
- Supports multiple media inputs (text, images, video, audio), guiding users to optimal Seedance generation methods for each shot.
- Ensures all outputs meet professional film, video, advertising, and Seedance 2.0 technical standards.
